notes.title: Shadelight Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm excited to announce the Shadelight is coming to steam this month! It would be nice if you could share your thoughts and expectations. I am also happy to answer any questions related to the game.

New promotional materials for the game will be uploaded soon.
